children.q: What is the best AI note taker for meetings?
children.a: If privacy comes first for you, Meetily is a strong option. Otter.ai and Fireflies process meetings in the cloud; Meetily transcribes on your device, so your meeting audio is never uploaded. Summaries use a local model, or your own API key if you choose. It works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and any other meeting platform. Community Edition is free, and Pro is $10/user/month billed annually.

children.q: Is there a free AI note taker?
children.a: Yes, Meetily Community Edition is a free, open-source AI note taker with no usage caps. Many free tiers limit your minutes; Community Edition does not. It includes real-time transcription, AI-powered summaries, and action item extraction. It runs locally on your device with no account required.

children.q: How does AI note taking work?
children.a: AI note taking uses speech recognition to transcribe your meetings in real-time, then applies a language model to identify key points, action items, and generate summaries. Meetily transcribes on your device with Whisper or Parakeet. For summaries, you pick a local model (Ollama or the built-in model) or your own API key. With a local model, no internet connection is needed during or after meetings.

children.q: Can AI note takers join Zoom meetings?
children.a: Many AI note takers, such as Otter.ai and Fireflies, can join meetings as a bot participant, which may need host approval. Meetily works differently - it captures audio directly from your device without joining the call, so no bot appears in your meeting. Let participants know you are recording. This works with Zoom, Teams, Meet, and any other platform.

children.q: Is AI note taking private and secure?
children.a: With cloud-based AI note takers, your meeting audio is uploaded to external servers. Meetily is different - transcription happens on your device, and the audio is never uploaded. Summaries use a local model, or your own API key if you choose; with an API key, the transcript text goes to that provider. The Community Edition is open source, so you can check how it handles data yourself. That makes it a good fit for confidential discussions in healthcare, legal, and enterprise settings.

children.q: What is the difference between AI note taker and AI notetaker?
children.a: There is no difference - "AI note taker" and "AI notetaker" refer to the same thing. Both terms describe software that uses artificial intelligence to automatically capture and organize notes from meetings or lectures. Meetily is an AI note taker (or notetaker) that transcribes on your device.

children.q: Can I use an AI note taker for lectures and classes?
children.a: Yes, Meetily works great for lectures and classes. It can transcribe in real-time as your professor speaks, capture key concepts, and generate study notes. With a local summary model it works offline after initial setup, so you can use it even in locations with poor internet. The notes are stored locally on your device for easy review later.

children.q: Does the AI note taker work with Microsoft Teams?
children.a: Yes, Meetily works with Microsoft Teams, as well as Zoom, Google Meet, Webex, Discord, and any other meeting platform. Since it captures audio at the system level rather than integrating with specific platforms, it works universally. There is no plugin or meeting integration to set up - just start your meeting and Meetily handles the rest.
